'''Nod Warfield''' was an individual who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] within the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Warfield oversaw the construction of the [[Tarkin (superweapon)|''Tarkin'']] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hockaleg]], in the [[Patriim system/Legends|Patriim system]].
